description: Rounded selectable label. A Button with a toggle state, always pill-shaped: quick actions, quick replies, pick-a-reason chips, filters, etc. Copy: names the filter it applies, not the act of filtering — "Overdue", not "Filter by overdue".

props.name: variant
props.description: How much the chip is claiming. `secondary` (default) is a label; `primary` is the one that is selected or active; `ghost` is a chip on a busy surface; `destructive` marks something failing.

props.name: size
props.description: Follows the row it sits in: `sm` inside a table cell or a dense toolbar, `md` on its own.

props.name: selected
props.description: Toggled/active state for pick-one or multi-select chip groups (primary fill).
